sections.Profile:
The "3-D" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in November 1958, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Backbox Gimmick, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
